Generic downloadHandler creator for ggplot objects

Source: R/utils_plot.R
utils_create_download_plot_handler.Rd

Creates a Shiny downloadHandler for exporting ggplot objects to file with dynamic filename, width, and height.

Usage

utils_create_download_plot_handler(
  plot_func,
  filename_func,
  width_func,
  height_func,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300
)

Arguments

plot_func

Function with no arguments returning a ggplot object.

filename_func

Function returning filename string.

width_func

Function returning width (numeric).

height_func

Function returning height (numeric).

units

Character; units for ggsave (default 'in').

dpi

Numeric; DPI for ggsave (default 300).

Value

A Shiny downloadHandler object to assign to output[[id]].
